name: Gironella (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a red saltire and three dark green pine cones of the arms, one at the hoist, one at the fly and one below the centre.
history: The flag was approved on 26 May 2006 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 4660 of 22 June 2006; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, yellow, with a red saltire of arms 5/36 of the height and the three dark green pine cones of the arms placed with the stalk upwards, each 1/4 of the height, those at the sides equidistant from the edges.

features.role: saltire with arms 5/36 of the height
three pine cones with the stalk upwards, 1/4 of the height
